(def reset!
  "Sets the value of atom to newval without regard for the
  current value. Returns new-value."
  (fn [a new-value]
    (if (instance? Atom a)
      (let [validate (.-validator a)]
        (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? validate)
          (when-not (validate new-value)
            (throw (suss.bootstrap/error "Invalid reference state"))))
        (let [old-value (.-state a)]
          (set! (.-state a) new-value)
          (when-not (suss.bootstrap/nil? (.-watches a))
            (-notify-watches a old-value new-value))
          new-value))
      (-reset! a new-value))))
rationale: Expand the complete pinned defn to def/fn, retaining its documentation. Validation follows Clojure's ARef: a falsy validator result throws "Invalid reference state" (ClojureScript says "Validator rejected reference state"), an exception from the validator propagates, and state is validated, then set, then watches are notified. Non-Atom references use IReset, as upstream.
